repairAssignments.decisiveDefect: A mapped known prefill is silently missing from the boundary artifact: participant.email is absent from 200-00132 page 1 on the boundary bytes while the same value is written on two other documents of the same artifact and the family's own report still counts it.

failedProofObligations.finding: One mapped known prefill is absent from the boundary artifact's bytes. participant.email is mapped to 200-00132 page 1 field "34i" (rect x395.69 y120.55 w174.74 h12.96) in both fixtures. The canonical artifact carries it: packet page 3 holds eight flattened widget appearances, the eighth reading "jordan.reyes@example.org". The boundary artifact carries only seven on the same page and the email is not among them, while the family's own report still records valuesReportedByFinalizer 8 for that document and fixture. The loss is silent — no refusal, no unfittable note, no finding. It is not a policy on long values either: the same boundary email, maria.alejandra.oshaughnessy.whitfield@longmailexample.org, is written and present on packet page 2 (200-00130) and packet page 5 (600-00228) of the same artifact.

The fee is not stated and no waiver route is established. The instructions say so themselves: "The filing fee, and whether it can be waived. Ask the clerk of the unit above what the fee is for a petition to seal under 13 V.S.A. § 7602, and whether the fee-waiver application in this packet applies. The waiver form is included; the amount it waives is not stated here." The waiver form 600-00228 is in the packet and filled, which is more than nothing, but the packet does not establish that it applies to this filing, and an instruction to ask the clerk is not the fee being stated.

Who must be served, and how, is not stated. The instructions say: "Who must be served, and how. Ask the same clerk who must receive a copy of the petition and by what method. The stipulation route needs the State's Attorney's signature, which is not the same thing as service and does not substitute for it." The packet correctly refuses to conflate the prosecutor's signature with service, and correctly declines to invent a rule, but neither a recipient nor a method is stated.

repairAssignments.decisiveDefect: The packet is silent on service. It never states who must be served, never states that no held source establishes a service rule, and names no authority for that question. Under DETERMINATION_FEE_AND_WAIVER_STANDARD.json the fee standard extends to SERVICE by its own appliesTo, and this is the notMet first limb: the packet says nothing about it anywhere.

whatIsHeldAndWhatIsNot.nothingIsHeld: No committed record establishes a service rule for Miss. Code Ann. § 99-15-59. The route contract src/lib/legal-authority/routes/mississippi.json routes[21] has no service key and the string 'serv' does not occur in it. There is no packet-set manifest entry for this composed family in data/record-clearing/legal-design-packet-set-manifests.json. The compiled Mississippi profile's one notice rule — 'The petitioner must give 10 days written notice to the district attorney before any hearing' — is cited to law.justia.com section-99-19-71 and keyed to § 99-19-71, so A3 bars reading it across to § 99-15-59.
whatIsHeldAndWhatIsNot.soThisIsNotAnA1Failure: The repair is NOT to publish the 10-day district-attorney notice. Doing so would be the sibling-route inference A3 exists to forbid, and the same trap A4 records West Virginia narrowly avoiding. Publishing a § 99-19-71 hearing-notice rule on a § 99-15-59 no-charge application would be a worse defect than the present silence.
whatIsHeldAndWhatIsNot.whatTheRepairIs: State the non-establishment and name the authority, exactly as this packet already does for the fee and delivery questions two sentences earlier.

advisoryNotAFailedObligation.finding: The packet scopes its non-establishment as 'no committed record this packet is built from', which is the packet's own inputs rather than A2's wider repository. I ran the wider search and the answer is the same — Mississippi's only held fee lines are keyed to §§ 99-19-71 and 99-19-72 and A3 excludes them — so the statement is true in substance and the obligation passes. But that narrower framing is precisely the reading A2 was written to correct, and it leaves the next reader to redo the search. Worth widening the words while the service paragraph is being edited.
